local_review.finding_body: The test build hardcoded `org.bytedeco:librealsense2-platform:2.53.1-1.5.9` even though the tested library version is TCK-resolved. This version-pinned dependency would keep a reused suite on the old native runtime and violates the version-agnostic test requirement in §FS-test-contract.2.5.
local_review.finding_title: Companion runtime dependency pins the tested library version
local_review.fix_note: Changed the companion `librealsense2-platform` runtime dependency to use `$libraryVersion`, keeping it aligned with the TCK-resolved tested version. The exact Forge-owned finalization command then completed successfully with no further publishable changes.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff, test source and build configuration, index and reported statistics. The tests exercise the library's public API in a separate package without scaffold code, Native Image dodging, visibility bypasses, or prohibited build flags. The reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case. After the repair, Forge finalization passed all three test lanes, metadata and style checks, test-only metadata splitting, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
